action_items: None for iteration 14 code — all resend + rate-limit behaviour on preview is correct.

PRODUCTION SMS DELIVERY (evergroemart.com): root cause per main agent is Firebase Console → Authorized Domains missing 'evergroemart.com' + 'www.evergroemart.com'. This is a Firebase console config the app owner must apply; not testable from preview. Confirm the two domains are added, and confirm Firebase Phone Auth quota/reCAPTCHA is enabled for the project (amora-b93c0).

Minor observation: backend resend_count for a fresh phone stays 0 on the first send and jumps to 1 on the first resend (formula `(existing.count or 0) + (1 if existing else 0)`). This is intentional per the request spec (0 first time, 1+ on resend) — confirmed correct.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /auth/otp/send: `is_prod` uses substring match (`ph.strip() in host`). 'evergroemart.com' would also match a malicious host like 'notevergroemart.com.attacker.tld'. Consider exact-suffix match with a leading dot for safety. Not blocking for this iteration.
server.py: 20s rate limit is per-phone only — an attacker who rotates phones can still spam SMS. Consider adding a per-IP rate limit before enabling live Firebase in production.

ResendOtpButton respects server 429 by parsing 'wait Ns' from the error detail (nice). But it uses regex /wait (\d+)s/ — if backend changes message format this will silently break. Consider returning `retry_after` in the JSON error body for a structured contract.
server.py has grown to 2417 lines (was 2411 last iteration) — still recommend router split (auth/orders/tracking/admin).

rca of the issue: User-reported 'OTP not delivering to phone on production' (evergroemart.com) is NOT fixable from code — root cause is Firebase Console configuration: the production hostname is not in Firebase Auth → Authorized Domains, so the Firebase JS SDK refuses to run recaptcha/sms flow. On PREVIEW the frontend explicitly bypasses Firebase via isFirebaseHostAllowed() and uses the backend dev-OTP fallback (which works and now has 20s rate limit + resend). Iteration 14 correctly (a) surfaces a clear warning toast on Firebase failure and (b) provides a Resend OTP UX on all 3 OTP screens. Definitive fix requires the app owner to add 'evergroemart.com' and 'www.evergroemart.com' to Firebase Console → Authentication → Settings → Authorized domains (project amora-b93c0).
